note: Written by tools/validate.mjs: every authored lesson, review, homework, exam, bank and drill file. js/content.js reads it so it never requests a file that does not exist. Run the validator after adding content. selfExams lists the exams that hold a self-marked item or a check part. examMinutes gives the minutes each exam runs. sessions lists the workshop and project lessons with their true minutes. lessonMinutes gives the authored minutes of every lesson and setMinutes the minutes a review or homework file states (the in-app hours). perf lists the levels that carry a performance task. samples lists the engine sample files (sample: true), which every learner-facing list leaves out.
